notes.title: Video player update
notes.content:
Hello to our dear and tiny community. 

Over the past 6 months we have received many requests about having an ability to load up videos from PC. After some delay and other technical issues we are happy to tell you that Sky Tower has now a video player.  I do apologize for taking so long time. Future updates and fixes will appear in faster rate. 

We also added an option to switch off the environment sounds so they will not intrude your videos.  Also the gramophone model has been changed. This will be a part of a future update where gramophone will play your mp3 files. Hopefully this would be an ideal way to relax and listen to your favorite music, podcasts and audiobooks. 

Thank you and Merry Christmas!
